statement: The authors report alpha-theory certification of at least one witness set attaining their observed maximum of 76 real points on SO(5). This is a lower bound on the maximum, not a proof that 76 is maximal.

answer.text: An example with 76 real section points was certified.
answer.display: An example with 76 real section points was certified.

source.location: Section 7, certification paragraph and Table 5, n=5

notes:
The paper says only selected maximum witnesses were certified; its full frequency table is numerical. Certificates were not rerun.
